fact: On 4 August 2026 the digital economy minister presented the national AI strategy (SNIA) at a government validation ceremony and said it would go to the Council of Ministers for adoption, with an interministerial steering mechanism still to be set up.
title: RDC : S.E Augustin Kibassa lance la Politique sectorielle de l'économie numérique et la Stratégie nationale de l'IA
publisher: Augustin Kibassa Maliba, ministre de l'Économie numérique
